prompt: Identify the part with the grammatical error (or 'No error').
sentence: By the time the rescue team reached (A) / the remote landslide location, (B) / the local villagers already cleared the debris. (C) / No Error (D)
options: By the time the rescue team reached (A)
the local villagers already cleared the debris. (C)
explanation: The earlier of two past actions needs the past perfect, so 'already cleared' should be 'had already cleared'.

prompt: Identify the part with the grammatical error (or 'No error').
